items.prompt: Complete the puzzle by filling every place. You have 1 large triangle, 1 small triangle and 1 square.
hints: Start with the biggest outline. It needs the large triangle.
Match a long straight edge of a piece to an edge of the outline. Tap Turn if the piece points the wrong way.
Tap a piece on the board to pick it up and try it in another place.
items.explanation: The 3 pieces fit together with no gaps: 1 large triangle, 1 small triangle and 1 square. Each piece fills one outline exactly.

items.prompt: Make a triangle on the geoboard.
hints: A triangle: check the number of sides and the corners before you close the shape.
Corners are where two sides meet. A peg in the middle of a straight side is not a corner.
If your shape is not right, tap Undo to remove the last corner and try another peg.
items.explanation: One answer uses the pegs (0,0), (3,0), (0,2). It has 3 sides, a perimeter of 8.6 and an area of 3 square units.
